name: Mathematics
description: Number, sets, algebra, commercial arithmetic, geometry, trigonometry, transformations, mensuration, longitude and latitude, statistics and probability for the Nigerian senior secondary curriculum, aligned to WAEC, NECO and JAMB.

topics.name: Number and Numeration
topics.summary: Number bases, fractions, approximation, standard form, ratio and percentage — the arithmetic foundation of every other topic.

subtopics.name: Number Bases
subtopics.summary: Reading, converting and calculating with numbers written in bases other than ten.

objectives.text: Convert a number from any base to base ten using place value
Convert a base ten number to another base by repeated division
Add, subtract and multiply numbers in a given base
Solve equations involving numbers written in different bases

subtopics.name: Fractions, Decimals and Percentages
subtopics.summary: Converting between the three forms and calculating with them in profit, loss and discount problems.

objectives.text: Convert freely between fractions, decimals and percentages
Add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions correctly
Calculate percentage increase, decrease, profit and loss
Apply percentages to simple interest and commission problems

subtopics.name: Approximation and Standard Form
subtopics.summary: Rounding to decimal places and significant figures, writing numbers in standard form and estimating percentage error.

objectives.text: Round numbers to a given number of decimal places
Round numbers to a given number of significant figures
Express large and small numbers in standard form
Calculate percentage error in a measurement

subtopics.name: Ratio, Proportion and Rate
subtopics.summary: Sharing quantities in a given ratio and solving direct and inverse proportion, speed and rate problems.

objectives.text: Simplify a ratio and share a quantity in a given ratio
Solve direct proportion problems using the unitary method
Solve inverse proportion problems involving work and time
Use rates such as speed and density in calculations

topics.name: Algebra
topics.summary: Working with variables, expressions and equations to describe and solve problems.

subtopics.name: Algebraic Expressions
subtopics.summary: Building, simplifying and evaluating expressions that contain variables.

objectives.text: Identify terms, coefficients and constants in an expression
Simplify expressions by collecting like terms
Evaluate an expression for given values of its variables

subtopics.name: Linear Equations
subtopics.summary: Solving equations in one variable by keeping both sides balanced.

objectives.text: Solve one-step linear equations using inverse operations
Solve two-step linear equations, keeping the equation balanced
Solve linear equations with the variable on both sides
Translate a word problem into a linear equation and solve it

subtopics.name: Expansion and Factorisation
subtopics.summary: Expanding brackets and reversing the process to write expressions as products of factors.

objectives.text: Expand products of two binomials
Factorise by taking out the highest common factor
Factorise quadratic trinomials by grouping
Recognise and factorise a difference of two squares

subtopics.name: Quadratic Equations
subtopics.summary: Solving equations of the form ax squared plus bx plus c equals zero by factorisation, completing the square and formula.

objectives.text: Solve quadratic equations by factorisation
Solve quadratic equations using the quadratic formula
Solve quadratic equations by completing the square
Use the sum and product of roots to form a quadratic equation

subtopics.name: Simultaneous Equations
subtopics.summary: Finding the pair of values that satisfies two equations at once by elimination and substitution.

objectives.text: Solve a pair of linear simultaneous equations by elimination
Solve a pair of linear simultaneous equations by substitution
Solve one linear and one quadratic equation simultaneously
Form and solve simultaneous equations from a word problem

subtopics.name: Linear Inequalities
subtopics.summary: Solving and representing inequalities in one variable on a number line.

objectives.text: Solve linear inequalities in one variable
Reverse the inequality sign when multiplying or dividing by a negative
Represent the solution of an inequality on a number line
Solve combined and word-problem inequalities

subtopics.name: Variation
subtopics.summary: Direct, inverse, joint and partial variation and the constant that links the quantities.

objectives.text: Write and use an equation for direct variation
Write and use an equation for inverse variation
Solve problems involving joint variation
Solve problems involving partial variation

topics.name: Indices, Logarithms and Surds
topics.summary: The laws of indices, the logarithm as the inverse of an index, and exact calculation with surds.

subtopics.name: Laws of Indices
subtopics.summary: Multiplying, dividing and raising powers, including zero, negative and fractional indices.

objectives.text: Apply the multiplication and division laws of indices
Evaluate zero and negative indices
Evaluate fractional indices as roots and powers
Solve simple indicial equations by equating indices

subtopics.name: Logarithms
subtopics.summary: Reading a logarithm as an index and using the laws of logarithms to simplify and solve.

objectives.text: Convert between index form and logarithmic form
Apply the product, quotient and power laws of logarithms
Evaluate logarithms to base ten and use the change of base rule
Solve equations involving logarithms

subtopics.name: Surds
subtopics.summary: Simplifying irrational roots, combining like surds and rationalising denominators.

objectives.text: Simplify a surd into its lowest form
Add, subtract and multiply surds
Rationalise a denominator containing a single surd
Rationalise a denominator using the conjugate

topics.name: Geometry
topics.summary: Angle facts, properties of triangles and polygons, and the circle theorems used in WAEC and JAMB proofs.

subtopics.name: Angles and Straight Lines
subtopics.summary: Angles on a line, at a point, and the angle relationships formed by a transversal cutting parallel lines.

objectives.text: Use angles on a straight line and at a point
Identify vertically opposite, corresponding and alternate angles
Use co-interior angles on parallel lines
Solve multi-step angle problems with reasons

subtopics.name: Triangles and Polygons
subtopics.summary: Angle sums, triangle types, Pythagoras' theorem and the interior and exterior angles of polygons.

objectives.text: Use the angle sum and exterior angle of a triangle
Apply the properties of isosceles and equilateral triangles
Apply Pythagoras' theorem in right-angled triangles
Calculate interior and exterior angles of a regular polygon

subtopics.name: Circle Theorems
subtopics.summary: Angles in circles, cyclic quadrilaterals and the properties of tangents and chords.

objectives.text: Use the angle at the centre and angle in the same segment theorems
Use the angle in a semicircle theorem
Apply the cyclic quadrilateral theorem
Apply tangent and chord properties including the alternate segment

topics.name: Mensuration
topics.summary: Perimeter, area, arc length, sector area, volume and surface area of plane shapes and solids.

subtopics.name: Perimeter and Area of Plane Shapes
subtopics.summary: Area and perimeter of rectangles, triangles, parallelograms, trapezia and circles.

objectives.text: Calculate the perimeter of composite plane shapes
Calculate the area of triangles and quadrilaterals
Calculate the area and circumference of a circle
Solve area problems involving unit conversion

subtopics.name: Arcs and Sectors
subtopics.summary: Using the angle at the centre as a fraction of a full turn to find arc length, sector area and segment area.

objectives.text: Calculate the length of an arc of a circle
Calculate the area of a sector of a circle
Find the perimeter of a sector including both radii
Relate a sector to the cone formed when it is folded

subtopics.name: Volume and Surface Area of Solids
subtopics.summary: Prisms, cylinders, cones, pyramids and spheres — volume, curved surface area and total surface area.

objectives.text: Calculate the volume of prisms and cylinders
Calculate the volume of cones, pyramids and spheres
Calculate curved and total surface area of solids
Solve problems involving capacity and density of solids

topics.name: Trigonometry
topics.summary: Trigonometric ratios in right-angled triangles, the sine and cosine rules, and bearings and distances.

subtopics.name: Trigonometric Ratios
subtopics.summary: Using sine, cosine and tangent to find unknown sides and angles in right-angled triangles.

objectives.text: Identify opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse in a right-angled triangle
Use sine, cosine and tangent to find an unknown side
Use inverse ratios to find an unknown angle
Apply trigonometry to angles of elevation and depression

subtopics.name: Sine and Cosine Rules
subtopics.summary: Solving non-right-angled triangles and finding area using half ab sine C.

objectives.text: Apply the sine rule to find a side or an angle
Apply the cosine rule to find a third side
Rearrange the cosine rule to find an angle
Find the area of a triangle using two sides and the included angle

subtopics.name: Bearings and Distances
subtopics.summary: Three-figure bearings, sketching journeys and using trigonometry to find distance and direction.

objectives.text: Write and interpret three-figure bearings
Find the back bearing of a given bearing
Draw a clear sketch of a journey from bearing information
Calculate distance and bearing using the sine and cosine rules

topics.name: Coordinate Geometry
topics.summary: Points, distance, midpoint, gradient and the equation of a straight line on the Cartesian plane.

subtopics.name: Distance and Midpoint
subtopics.summary: Using Pythagoras' theorem to find the distance between two points and averaging to find the midpoint.

objectives.text: Plot and read points on the Cartesian plane
Calculate the distance between two points
Calculate the midpoint of a line segment
Use distance and midpoint to identify shapes

subtopics.name: Gradient and Equation of a Line
subtopics.summary: Gradient as rise over run, the forms of a linear equation, and conditions for parallel and perpendicular lines.

objectives.text: Calculate the gradient of a line through two points
Find the equation of a line in the form y equals mx plus c
Use the condition for parallel and perpendicular lines
Find intercepts and sketch a straight line graph

topics.name: Statistics
topics.summary: Collecting and presenting data, then summarising it with averages and measures of spread.

subtopics.name: Data Presentation
subtopics.summary: Frequency tables, bar charts, pie charts, histograms and cumulative frequency curves.

objectives.text: Build a frequency table from raw data
Construct and interpret bar charts and pie charts
Construct and interpret histograms of grouped data
Read quartiles from a cumulative frequency curve

subtopics.name: Measures of Central Tendency
subtopics.summary: Mean, median and mode for raw, ungrouped and grouped data, and when each is the fairest average.

objectives.text: Calculate the mean of raw and ungrouped frequency data
Find the median of a data set including even counts
Identify the mode and the modal class
Estimate the mean of grouped data using class midpoints

subtopics.name: Measures of Dispersion
subtopics.summary: Range, interquartile range, mean deviation, variance and standard deviation as measures of spread.

objectives.text: Calculate the range and the interquartile range
Calculate the mean deviation of a data set
Calculate variance and standard deviation
Compare the spread of two data sets

topics.name: Probability
topics.summary: Measuring how likely an event is, and combining probabilities for two or more events.

subtopics.name: Simple Probability
subtopics.summary: Sample space, equally likely outcomes and the probability of a single event and its complement.

objectives.text: List the sample space of a simple experiment
Calculate the probability of a single event
Use the complement rule to find the probability of not happening
Estimate probability from experimental or survey data

subtopics.name: Combined Events
subtopics.summary: The addition rule for mutually exclusive events and the multiplication rule for independent events, with and without replacement.

objectives.text: Apply the addition rule to mutually exclusive events
Apply the multiplication rule to independent events
Handle selection with and without replacement
Use tree diagrams to solve two-stage probability problems

topics.name: Sequences and Series
topics.summary: Patterns of numbers, the nth term, and sums of arithmetic and geometric progressions.

subtopics.name: Arithmetic Progression
subtopics.summary: Sequences with a common difference: the nth term, the sum of n terms and word problems.

objectives.text: Identify an arithmetic progression and its common difference
Use the formula for the nth term of an arithmetic progression
Use the formula for the sum of an arithmetic progression
Solve arithmetic progression problems given two terms

subtopics.name: Geometric Progression
subtopics.summary: Sequences with a common ratio: the nth term, the sum of n terms and the sum to infinity.

objectives.text: Identify a geometric progression and its common ratio
Use the formula for the nth term of a geometric progression
Use the formula for the sum of a geometric progression
Find the sum to infinity of a convergent geometric progression

topics.name: Sets
topics.summary: Set language, Venn diagrams and applications used throughout WAEC and JAMB quantitative reasoning.

subtopics.name: Set Language
subtopics.summary: Elements, subsets, union, intersection, complement and the empty set.

objectives.text: Define a set and use roster and set-builder notation
Identify subsets, the universal set and the empty set
Find union, intersection and complement of sets

subtopics.name: Venn Diagrams
subtopics.summary: Two- and three-set diagrams, and how regions map to set operations.

objectives.text: Draw and shade two-set and three-set Venn diagrams
Translate worded survey data into a Venn diagram
Read n(A ∪ B) and n(A ∩ B) from a completed diagram

subtopics.name: Applications of Sets
subtopics.summary: Survey and word problems that WAEC sets on two and three overlapping groups.

objectives.text: Solve two-set word problems using n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B)
Solve three-set problems by filling regions from the inside out
Interpret 'only A' and 'neither' in exam wording

topics.name: Commercial Arithmetic
topics.summary: Percentages, profit and loss, interest and hire purchase — the money calculations on every WAEC paper.

subtopics.name: Percentages, Profit and Loss
subtopics.summary: Percentage change, profit, loss, discount and VAT in market contexts.

objectives.text: Convert between percentages, fractions and decimals
Calculate profit, loss and percentage profit or loss
Find selling price after discount or VAT

subtopics.name: Simple and Compound Interest
subtopics.summary: I = PRT/100 and compound growth over successive years.

objectives.text: Calculate simple interest and the amount after a given time
Calculate compound interest year by year or with A = P(1 + r/100)^n
Compare simple and compound interest on the same principal

subtopics.name: Hire Purchase
subtopics.summary: Deposits, instalments and the extra cost of buying on hire purchase.

objectives.text: Find the hire-purchase price from deposit and instalments
Calculate the extra cost compared with the cash price
Solve exam problems involving a deposit and equal monthly payments

topics.name: Geometric Transformations
topics.summary: Reflection, rotation, translation and enlargement on the coordinate plane.

subtopics.name: Reflection and Rotation
subtopics.summary: Images of points and shapes under reflection in the axes and rotation about the origin.

objectives.text: Reflect a point in the x-axis, y-axis and the line y = x
Rotate a point 90° and 180° about the origin
Describe a single transformation that maps one shape onto another

subtopics.name: Translation and Enlargement
subtopics.summary: Column-vector translations and enlargements from a centre with a given scale factor.

objectives.text: Translate a shape by a column vector
Enlarge a shape from a centre with a positive or fractional scale factor
Find a scale factor from corresponding lengths

topics.name: Earth Geometry
topics.summary: Longitude, latitude and distances on the Earth's surface — a standing WAEC topic.

subtopics.name: Longitude and Latitude
subtopics.summary: Locating a place on the globe and reading parallels and meridians.

objectives.text: Define latitude, longitude, equator, Greenwich meridian and the poles
State the coordinates of a place from a sketch of the globe
Distinguish parallels of latitude from meridians of longitude

subtopics.name: Distances on the Earth
subtopics.summary: Nautical-mile distances along a meridian or the equator, and time differences.

objectives.text: Calculate the distance between two places on the same meridian
Calculate the distance between two places on the equator
Relate 15° of longitude to one hour of time difference

topics.name: JSS Number Work
topics.summary: Whole numbers, LCM and HCF, directed numbers — NERDC JSS1 Mathematics first term.

subtopics.name: Whole Numbers and Primes
subtopics.summary: Place value, prime factors, and the four operations on whole numbers.

objectives.text: Write whole numbers in standard form at JSS level
Find prime factors of a whole number
Add, subtract, multiply and divide whole numbers accurately

subtopics.name: LCM and HCF
subtopics.summary: Lowest common multiple and highest common factor, with squares and square roots.

objectives.text: Find the LCM of two or three numbers
Find the HCF of two or three numbers
Use LCM and HCF in a simple word problem

subtopics.name: Directed Numbers
subtopics.summary: Positive and negative numbers and the four operations on them.

objectives.text: Place directed numbers on a number line
Add and subtract directed numbers
Multiply and divide directed numbers

topics.name: JSS Shapes and Graphs
topics.summary: Plane shapes, scale drawing, simple graphs — NERDC JSS1 second and third terms.

subtopics.name: Plane Shapes
subtopics.summary: Squares, rectangles, parallelograms, rhombuses and kites in the environment.

objectives.text: Name common plane shapes and state their properties
Identify plane shapes in everyday objects
Solve a simple quantitative problem on a plane shape

subtopics.name: Scale Drawing
subtopics.summary: Representing real lengths on paper using a scale.

objectives.text: Explain what a scale drawing is for
Convert a real length to a drawing length using a scale
Read a distance from a simple scale drawing

subtopics.name: Simple Graphs
subtopics.summary: The Cartesian plane and graphs of linear relations from real life.

objectives.text: Plot a point on the Cartesian plane
Draw a simple linear graph from a table of values
Read information from a straight-line graph

topics.name: Further Number (WAEC)
topics.summary: Modular arithmetic, logical reasoning, matrices and binary operations from the WAEC General Mathematics syllabus.

subtopics.name: Modular Arithmetic
subtopics.summary: Clock and market-day arithmetic: a ≡ b (mod n).

objectives.text: Explain a ≡ b (mod n) with a clock or market-day example
Add, subtract and multiply in a given modulus
Solve a simple congruence used in daily life

subtopics.name: Logical Reasoning
subtopics.summary: Statements, negation and implication as listed in the WAEC syllabus.

objectives.text: Identify a simple statement as true or false
Write the negation of a simple statement
Interpret an implication 'if p then q'

subtopics.name: 2-by-2 Matrices
subtopics.summary: WAEC restricts matrices to order 2×2, including determinants and 2×2 simultaneous equations.

objectives.text: Identify the order and type of a 2×2 matrix
Add, subtract and multiply 2×2 matrices
Use a determinant to solve two linear equations

subtopics.name: Binary Operations
subtopics.summary: An operation * defined on a set, as in the WAEC algebraic-processes section.

objectives.text: Evaluate a * b for a given binary operation
Test a simple operation for commutativity
Find an identity element when it exists

topics.name: Further Algebra and Geometry (WAEC)
topics.summary: Change of subject, quadratic graphs, constructions, loci and vectors from the WAEC syllabus.

subtopics.name: Change of Subject
subtopics.summary: Rearranging a formula and substituting, e.g. v = u + at.

objectives.text: Make a specified variable the subject of a formula
Substitute given values after changing the subject
Rearrange a formula that includes a square or a fraction

subtopics.name: Graphs of Quadratic Functions
subtopics.summary: Tables of values, intercepts, turning point and using a tangent for gradient.

objectives.text: Complete a table of values for y = ax² + bx + c
Read intercepts and the turning point from a sketch
Estimate the gradient at a point by drawing a tangent

subtopics.name: Constructions and Loci
subtopics.summary: WAEC plane-geometry items: bisectors, triangles and simple loci.

objectives.text: Describe how to bisect a line or an angle
State the locus of points equidistant from two points or two lines
Identify the locus that matches a given worded condition

subtopics.name: Vectors
subtopics.summary: Column vectors, addition and scalar multiplication on the plane.

objectives.text: Write a displacement as a column vector
Add two vectors and multiply a vector by a scalar
Find the magnitude of a 2-D vector

sources.title: WAEC Further and General Mathematics Syllabus — Algebraic Processes
JAMB Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination Mathematics Syllabus
